assumptions.assumptions: t5 needs an appropriate independent block-effect model; conditional sign bound can fail with dependent or biased blocks. Fixed mirrored order does not prove independence.
assumptions.margins_and_stopping: No equivalence margin, magnitude cutoff, optional stopping, sample replacement, pilot pooling or result-dependent family/weight/order change.
assumptions.method: qualified summarize(six log effects), pointwise two-sided95% t5
assumptions.multiplicity: One prespecified candidate contrast and one scalar selection endpoint. Under suitable independent representative symmetric-null block signs, all-six primary signs has bound1/64. Eight cell intervals and three secondary scalar intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous95% family bands; report all, never select a favorable subset.
assumptions.primary_gain: all six effects strictly positive AND lower log interval strictly positive
assumptions.region_loss: any upper required-cell log interval strictly negative vetoes, without all-six-loss condition
assumptions.units: six paired whole blocks; processes and requests are not independent samples
assumptions.unresolved_required_cells: Reuse adopted policy prospectively: complete the fixed cohort and report primary and all cells; uncertainty remains verification-blocked, never no-loss or equivalence. No shipping promotion unless D6/D15 are satisfied by evidence or structural unaffected proof. This does not pause independent candidate work. Any new independent holdout needs a fresh prospective registration, never an optional extension or unregistered pooling.
assumptions.zero_crossing: uncertain, never equivalent or zero loss

analysis.interpretation: Six paired whole blocks only. One fixed candidate contrast/scalar primary; eight required and three secondary intervals are POINTWISE, not simultaneous family bands. Any adverse required-cell upperlog<0 vetoes even without all-six losses. NS/zero crossing is unresolved, never equivalence/no-loss; no margin or optional extension/pilot pooling. Secondary costs are retained, not independent invented vetoes; lower-priority selection needs separate higher-priority equivalence evidence.

capacity.between_blocks: Retain every task-owned arm/block cache through the complete fixed cohort when fresh actual capacity is sufficient. Never delete between cold/warm pair members or touch shared/permanent/model caches.
capacity.private_caches: one new cache per arm/block; both cold and warm processes share only that cache
capacity.whole_cohort_prerequisite: Root fresh normal-space and resource admission for the declared whole cohort. Mature separately qualified obsolete source-capture retirement can provide space; no new cache-prune implementation is required when capacity is sufficient. Estimates are not upper bounds. Capacity failure stops and preserves the incomplete cohort; it does not reduce the fixed sample or permit partial selection.

execution.endpoint_visibility: No comparative endpoint peeking before complete fixed new cohort. AS failed/incomplete, FP8 pilot/depth/profile/source controls excluded from estimates.
execution.failure: Stop on any failed position or missing retirement, preserve/export all raw evidence, no retry or selection from partial cohort.
execution.first_use: All natural compilation/import and residual deferred work counted where it occurs. Prepared source moves only selected factory calls into init; no observer warming/fake Tensor/proposal/KV operation or loss forgiveness.

full_request_body_identity.scope: All four full request bodies remain byte-valued from this fixed phase. Ordinary serve CLI retains every setting except the declared F8 --drafter-bits16 to8 change; A16 is unchanged. No prompt truncation/body rewrite/new runtime callable replacement.

method_reference.scope: Qualified method/source-only, no AS observations or inherited approval of new image.
